title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for an AI startup for private credit managers | TechCrunch
summary: Ellis AI announced Thursday its emergence from stealth with $10 million in seed funding from investors including First Round Capital, 645 Ventures, Harlem Capital, Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Slow Capital, and Ariel Alternatives CEO Mellody Hobson.
